name: 鄭辰仰
objective: This graduate-level course examines e-Business management from both managerial and research perspectives. The course covers digital transformation, digital platforms, enterprise systems, data-driven management, emerging technologies, and Generative AI applications. In addition to lectures and case studies, students will critically read and analyze international journal articles, lead paper presentations, participate in research seminars, and evaluate research methods, findings, limitations, and implications. Special attention will be given to emerging technology trends and their impacts on organizations, business models, and future research.
schedule:
Week 1. Introduction to e-Business Management and Digital Transformation

Week 2. Digital Economy, e-Business Models, and Emerging Business Trends

Week 3. Digital Platforms, Ecosystems, and Platform Strategy

Week 4. Enterprise Systems, ERP, and Digital Integration

Week 5. Digital Supply Chains and Smart Operations

Week 6. Data-Driven Management and Business Analytics

Week 7. International Journal Reading: How to Read and Analyze Academic Papers

Week 8. Research Seminar I: Journal Paper Presentation and Critical Discussion

Week 9. Emerging Technologies and Digital Business Innovation

Week 10. Artificial Intelligence and Intelligent Business Applications

Week 11. Generative AI: Technologies, Applications, and Business Transformation

Week 12. Generative AI for Knowledge Work, Decision-Making, and Research

Week 13. AI Agents, Agentic AI, and Intelligent Business Automation

Week 14. Research Seminar II: Critical Analysis of Emerging Technology Research

Week 15. Research Seminar III: Student-Led Journal Paper Presentations and Discussion

Week 16. Future of e-Business: Research Trends, Opportunities, and Research Agenda
scorePolicy:
Class Participation and Research Discussion: 20%

International Journal Paper Presentation: 25%

Critical Review and Research Analysis: 25%

Final Research Project and Presentation: 30%
materials: Instructor-prepared lecture slides, selected international journal articles, business cases, industry reports, and recent publications on e-Business, digital transformation, emerging technologies, artificial intelligence, and Generative AI.
consultation: Students may contact the instructor by email (cycheng@ntut.edu.tw) to schedule an appointment for course consultation, journal paper discussion, research guidance, or other course-related questions.
延伸教學與資源: ● 參與式創新教學 (Participatory & Innovative Teaching) 強調學生參與與產出，導入翻轉、PBL/專題、設計思考或遊戲化等策略。Emphasizes student engagement and outcomes by adopting strategies such as Flipped Classroom, PBL (Problem/Project- Based Learning), Design Thinking, or Gamification.● 數位科技融入 (Digital Technology Integration) 運用生成式 AI、VR/AR、IoT、IRS 等新興科技輔助教學與評量。Utilizes emerging technologies such as Generative AI, VR/AR, IoT, and IRS (Interactive Response Systems) to facilitate teaching and assessment.● 數位教材資源應用 (Application of Digital Resources) 採用影音多媒體或具開放授權之資源（如 OCW、開放教科書）作為主要或輔助教材。Adopts multimedia or open-licensed resources (e.g., OCW, Open Textbooks) as primary or supplementary teaching materials.
課程對應SDGs指標: SDG4：優質教育（Quality Education）SDG8：尊嚴就業與經濟發展（Decent Work and Economic Growth）SDG9：產業創新與基礎設施（Industry, Innovation and Infrastructure）
課程是否導入AI: ● 使用生成式 AI 作為教學過程的輔助工具（Use generative AI tools as an aid to the teaching process）● 鼓勵學生使用生成式 AI 工具（Encourage students to use generative AI tools）● 使用生成式 AI 進行課堂即時互動（Use generative AI for real-time classroom interaction）● 簡單介紹 AI 的基本概念（Briefly introduce the basic concept of AI）● 深入探討 AI 的原理與應用（Explore the principles and applications of AI in depth）
remarks: This course is conducted in English and designed as a research-oriented graduate seminar. Students are expected to actively participate in discussions, critically analyze international journal articles, and present research papers in English. Generative AI tools may be used to support literature analysis and research exploration; however, students are responsible for verifying AI-generated information and demonstrating independent critical thinking.
